metadata.comment: ConfirmDebit -> INDETERMINATE (Document 05 Scenario C; bd babelstone-t7o3.10). The network dropped after the debit was sent, so the ACL cannot yet confirm whether the Core executed it. Higher-priority mapping; fires when the request body contains the marker 'indeterminate', letting a dev/demo drive the saga into AWAIT_CORE_CLEARANCE without a second stub. The signal is HTTP 202 Accepted -- an EXPLICIT indeterminate, distinct from a 2xx-success confirm (debits-success), a 4xx refusal, or a 5xx/timeout transient. The dispatcher classifies 202 on a ConfirmDebit as Indeterminate and the bridge synthesizes CoreDebitIndeterminate (ADR-IC-003 P5: a first-class wait, never a blind retry).
